create_em.tuned_link.mode.normal: Mode: normal - transmits while the input is powered
create_em.tuned_link.mode.selector: Mode: selector - a pulse latches it, others on the frequency turn off
block.create_em.electric_catalyst.toolti: _Water_, _campfire_, _lava_ and _soul fire_ in one casing. Place it in a _fan's_ air flow and power it with _FE_. Air passes through it.
Picks the mode by hand or leaves it to the _redstone signal_. _R-Click_ the box on a face, like on Create machines.
Goes dark. _Hotter_ modes use _more_ FE; to restart it stores a second of work first.
block.create_em.tuned_link.tooltip.summa: A _Redstone Link_ that sends a _set strength_ instead of its input. Any regular Create _receiver_ picks it up.
block.create_em.tuned_link.tooltip.behav: Sends the set strength _0-15_ on its frequency, even if the input is only _1_.
A _pulse_ from a button latches it on. Other _selectors on the same frequency_ turn off, like a program switch.
block.create_em.andesite_energy_meter.to: Household _meter_. Takes energy only from a _service line_ and counts what the consumer _actually received_.
Trips its _breaker_. Re-arm it in the meter menu once the debt is paid.
block.create_em.brass_energy_meter.toolt: Industrial _meter_ with _nixie tubes_ and a high limit. Takes energy only from a _service line_.
_Switches back on_ by itself. The supplier can control it _remotely_.
block.create_em.line_transformer.tooltip: Takes _FE_ from the sides and bottom and feeds it over the _service line_ to every meter _sealed_ by its owner.
block.create_em.smart_transformer.toolti: A _line transformer_ with a _supplier panel_: customers, tariff, currency, terms and vault.
block.create_em.line_connector.tooltip.s: _Insulator_ for poles and branches of a service line. Holds up to _8 wires_.
item.create_em.line_wire.tooltip.summary: Connects _service line nodes_. Regular wires do not attach to them.
item.create_em.line_wire.tooltip.action1: First click starts the wire, second click _connects_.
item.create_em.seal.tooltip.summary: Makes you the meter's _supplier_. Without a seal the transformer _won't feed_ it.
item.create_em.seal.tooltip.condition1: If the meter is broken or moved
item.create_em.seal.tooltip.behaviour1: The seal is _broken_ and the supplier is notified.
item.create_em.seal.tooltip.action1: Seals it. Shift on your own meter _removes the seal_.
block.create_em.billing_terminal.tooltip: _Pay desk_ for electricity. Accepts the _currency_ of any supplier you have an account with.
block.create_em.battery.tooltip.summary: Stores _FE_. Accepts from the sides, back and bottom, _outputs upward_. Batteries can be _stacked_. Keeps its _charge_ when broken.
block.create_em.battery.tooltip.behaviou: Shows the charge in four bars. A _comparator_ reads the charge.
block.create_em.battery.tooltip.conditio: As a reserve for the transfer switch
block.create_em.battery.tooltip.behaviou: Connect the battery output (top) to the _right_ side of the switch, e.g. with a _power cable_. While the main input works, the charge is kept.
_Automatic transfer switch_. Facing the panel: _input 1 on the left_ (main), _input 2 on the right_ (reserve), _output on top_.
Switches to the reserve at once and emits a _redstone signal of 15_ on all sides - use it to start a backup engine.
Waits for _3 seconds_ of stable supply, then switches back. The reserve is _not used_ while the main input works.
block.create_em.mini_meter.tooltip.summa: Inline _wattmeter_. Not bound to anyone and does not bill - its _nixie tubes_ show how many _FE/t_ the consumer _actually uses_ (what goes into its own buffer is not counted).
block.create_em.mini_meter.tooltip.behav: Looking at the display, _input is on the left_, _output on the right_. Works with any FE cables and blocks, including _Create: New Age_ connectors.
The display _blinks 9999_; the exact value is shown in engineer's goggles.
block.create_em.capacitor.tooltip.summar: Stores _FE_ and releases it _all at once_ - the whole charge in one tick. Back is _charging_ (blue "-"), front is _discharge_ (orange "+").
block.create_em.capacitor.tooltip.behavi: Emits _0-15_ on the sides and bottom by charge. Full is _15_.
Set by the switch: _when full_, _on a signal_ to the lid (a button right on it) or _never_. If the output takes nothing for a second, the discharge stops and no energy is lost.
block.create_em.capacitor.tooltip.action: Upper box - _when to discharge_, lower box - _how much to store_ (threshold; the gauge and signal use it too).
block.create_em.power_cable.tooltip.summ: Heavy cable for _huge flows_: stores nothing and has _no flow limit_, so it survives a capacitor discharge. Connects to other cables and any _FE block_.
block.create_em.power_cable.tooltip.beha: Splits it _evenly_ between all blocks at the ends of the network, except where it came from.
block.create_em.electrifier.tooltip.summ: Dumps _FE_ into the air as discharges. Stores _nothing_ - everything it gets shocks creatures around it.
block.create_em.electrifier.tooltip.beha: The _more energy_ arrives, the harder the shock: _400 FE_ per heart by default. A capacitor discharge hits _at once_ and very hard.
Set with the box _on top or bottom_ of the block, _3_ by default (maximum in config).
block.create_em.knife_switch.tooltip.sum: Breaks an _FE circuit_. Place it between source and consumer: facing the handle, _input is on the left_, _output on the right_.
block.create_em.knife_switch.tooltip.act: Switch _on_ or _off_. When off nothing passes.
create_em.panel.notice_tariff: Your supplier set your tariff: %s cr. per %s
create_em.panel.notice_prepaid: You are now prepaid: energy is charged at once, power is cut at zero balance
create_em.panel.notice_postpaid: You are now postpaid: a bill comes once per period
create_em.stage.notice.prepaid_empty: Prepaid balance is empty - power is off. Top up at a billing terminal.
create_em.public.unsealed: The meter is not sealed - there is no supplier
create_em.public.no_money: Your balance is empty - top it up at a billing terminal
create_em.public.debt: Access denied: debt or switched off by supplier
create_em.public.started: Session started - energy goes to your account. R-Click again to finish.
create_em.public.stopped: Session closed: used %s, to pay ≈ %s cr.
create_em.public.auto_stopped: Session closed automatically (you left or idle): used %s, to pay ≈ %s cr.
create_em.public.hint: R-Click to start a session on your account
block.create_em.public_meter.tooltip.sum: A meter _for everyone_: shared furnace, smelter, workshop. Used _in turns_, consumption goes _to whoever opened the session_, at their tariff.
block.create_em.public_meter.tooltip.act: _Start_ a session on your account or _finish_ yours.
block.create_em.public_meter.tooltip.beh: The session closes itself: logged out or farther than _24 blocks_ for 10 s, or nothing used for _a minute_.
create_em.gov.infinite_off: State substation: only from connected generators
create_em.gov.sealed: Meter sealed by the State Grid
create_em.gov.seal_hint: Connects a meter to the State Grid. Energy flows only if its owner is allowed (/create_em gov allow).
create_em.gov.denied: %s can no longer use state energy
block.create_em.state_substation.tooltip: Source of _state energy_. Placed and configured by _operators_ only, breakable only in creative.
Only meters with a _state seal_ whose owner is on the _access list_. For a public meter - whoever opened the session.
Toggle: _infinite energy_ or only from connected generators.
item.create_em.state_seal.tooltip.summar: A _State Grid_ seal. No recipe - given by _operators_. Only an operator can remove it (Shift R-Click).
create_em.mark.done: Block tagged: energy only through your state connectors
create_em.mark.no_energy: This block has no energy to isolate
create_em.mark.not_yours: You can only tag energy blocks you placed yourself
create_em.mark.connector: State connectors don't need a tag
create_em.mark.protected: Block is state-tagged (%s) and can't be broken
create_em.connector.mode_in: State connector: energy towards the plate
create_em.connector.mode_out: State connector: energy away from the plate
create_em.connector.protected: State connector (%s) can only be broken by its owner
item.create_em.state_mark.tooltip.summar: Turns an energy block into a _state device_: it accepts and gives FE _only_ to state connectors and other state devices of _the same owner_. Ordinary cables and other mods' connectors _won't connect_.
item.create_em.state_mark.tooltip.behavi: Only energy blocks _you placed yourself_. A tagged block can only be broken by the _tag owner_, its placer or an operator; explosions and contraptions _don't affect_ it.
item.create_em.state_mark.tooltip.action: _Tag_ it. On a tagged block, shows the owner.
_Remove_ the tag; it returns to your inventory.
A one-way _valve_ of the state grid between two state blocks. Doesn't work with ordinary blocks — both sides must be your state devices or state connectors.
Works only between blocks under _your_ tag and your state connectors. Only the _owner_ can break, rotate or switch it.
Direction: _towards the plate_ (ring) or _away from it_ (cross).
item.create_em.state_mark.tooltip.behavi: The _whole connected run_ of your cables is tagged with one tag. State cable and ordinary cable never form one network.
